title: Induction Machine Field-Oriented Control (Single-Phase)
text: 标幺制离散时间单相感应电机磁场定向控制，输入 3 路、输出 2 路；{Control mode} 控制模式 Speed、{Rated electrical frequency (Hz)} 指定额定电频率、{Number of pole pairs} 指定极对数、{Main winding rotor resistance, Rar’ (Ohm)} 指定主绕组转子电阻、{Main winding rotor leakage inductance, Llar’ (H)} 指定主绕组转子漏电感、{Main winding mutual inductance, Lms (H)} 指定主绕组互感、{Auxiliary/main windings turn ratio} 指定辅助绕组与主绕组的匝数比、{Fundamental sample time (s)} 指定模块采样时间 5e-6、{Control sample time (s)} 控制采样时间 5e-5、{Speed controller proportional gain} 指定速度控制器比例增益、{Speed controller integral gain} 指定速度控制器积分增益、{Speed controller integral anti-windup gain} 指定速度控制器积分抗饱和增益、{Maximum torque (Nm)} 指定最大转矩、{Minimum torque (Nm)} 指定最小转矩、{Rated flux (Wb)} 指定额定磁链、{Control type} 控制类型 Hysteresis、{Current hysteresis band (A)} 指定电流滞环带宽、{A-phase current proportional gain} 指定主绕组电流比例增益、{A-phase current integral gain} 指定主绕组电流积分增益、{A-phase current anti-windup gain} 指定主绕组电流抗积分饱和增益、{B-phase current proportional gain} 指定辅助绕组电流比例增益、{B-phase current integral gain} 指定辅助绕组电流积分增益、{B-phase current anti-windup gain} 指定辅助绕组电流抗积分饱和增益，按实例取值。
